event-booking/uncertainty/refund-amount.why_it_matters: Decides how much money is returned on cancellation and whether late cancellation loses the fee.

options.label: Full refund if cancelled 7 or more days before the event, none after.
options.explanation: Simple for attendees; organisers lose late seats.
effects: Simple for attendees; organisers lose late seats.
impact: Full refund if cancelled 7 or more days before the event, none after.
rule_claims: A booking cancelled 7 or more days before the event is refunded in full.
A booking cancelled less than 7 days before the event is not refunded.

options.label: Full refund 7 or more days before, half refund from 1 to 6 days, none on the event day.
options.explanation: Fairer to late cancellers; harder to explain.
effects: Fairer to late cancellers; harder to explain.
impact: Full refund 7 or more days before, half refund from 1 to 6 days, none on the event day.
rule_claims: A booking cancelled 7 or more days before the event is refunded in full.
A booking cancelled 1 to 6 days before the event is refunded by half.
A booking cancelled on the event day is not refunded.

event-booking/uncertainty/waitlist-offer.why_it_matters: Decides whether a freed seat can sit unused while others wait.

options.label: The offer ends after 24 hours and goes to the next attendee.
impact: The offer ends after 24 hours and goes to the next attendee.
rule_claims: An offered seat that is not accepted within 24 hours is offered to the next attendee on the waiting list.

options.label: The offer stays open until the event starts.
options.explanation: Fair to the first attendee; can leave seats empty.
effects: Fair to the first attendee; can leave seats empty.
impact: The offer stays open until the event starts.
rule_claims: An offered seat stays reserved for its attendee until the event starts.
